description: Create the error catalogue, validation engine, and BOM pipeline orchestration - the core execution layer for Sprint 7
steps: Create src/engines/errorCatalogue.ts with all structured error codes: 19 geometry errors (GEO_ZONE_OVERLAP, GEO_ZONE_OUTSIDE_WALL, GEO_ZONE_TOO_SMALL, GEO_ZONE_TOO_LARGE, GEO_ZONE_NEGATIVE_DIMENSION, GEO_ZONE_INVALID_POSITION, GEO_ZONE_EXCEEDS_WALL, GEO_GAP_TOO_SMALL, GEO_GAP_TOO_LARGE, GEO_PANEL_TOO_SMALL, GEO_PANEL_TOO_LARGE, GEO_RETAINED_BELOW_MIN, GEO_TRIM_EXCEEDS_PANEL, GEO_TOTAL_WIDTH_MISMATCH, GEO_TOTAL_HEIGHT_MISMATCH, GEO_ZONE_COUNT_EXCEEDED, GEO_ZONE_ASPECT_RATIO, GEO_WALL_DIMENSION_INVALID, GEO_ZONE_MIN_DIMENSION), 3 construction errors (CONST_MISSING_REQUIRED_COMPONENT, CONST_INVALID_MOUNTING, CONST_STRUCTURE_REQUIRED), 2 compatibility errors (COMPAT_INCOMPATIBLE_SKUS, COMPAT_MISSING_REQUIRED), 3 permission errors (PERM_LOCKED_PARAMETER, PERM_VALUE_OUT_OF_RANGE, PERM_INVALID_SKU_SELECTION), 1 quantity error (QTY_PANEL_NO_VALID_ARRANGEMENT). Each error has code, severity (BLOCKING/WARNING), category, and messageTemplate. Export PipelineError interface and createPipelineError helper.

Create src/engines/validationEngine.ts implementing 5 validation functions: validatePermissions(snapshotPermissions, consultantActions) - checks against template_consultant_permission rules; checkCompatibility(skuPairs, compatibilityRules) - checks sku_compatibility relationships; validateGeometry(zones, wallDimensions) - implements 19 geometry rules; validateConstruction(bomLines, mountingRules) - checks mounting and structure; validateBom(finalLines) - final coherence checks. Each returns { passed: boolean, errors: PipelineError[], warnings: PipelineError[] }.

Create src/engines/bomPipeline.ts with BomPipelineInput interface (snapshotData, measurements, configuration, ruleSet, permissions, compatibilityRules) and BomPipelineOutput interface ({ actualBomLines: [], errors: [], warnings: [], status: 'SUCCESS' | 'BLOCKED' }). Implement runBomPipeline() that executes 8 steps in order: (1) Permission Validation, (2) Site Adaptation (calls adaptZonesToSite), (3) SKU Compatibility Check, (4) Geometry Validation, (5) Construction Validation, (6) Quantity Calculation (calls wallPanel/light/furniture/hiddenComponent engines), (7) BOM Reconciliation, (8) Final BOM Validation. Each step that returns blocking errors stops the pipeline and returns BLOCKED status. Warnings accumulate but don't stop execution.
Update src/engines/index.ts to export runBomPipeline, all validation functions, error catalogue types and helpers.
Create src/engines/__tests__/errorCatalogue.test.ts - test that all error codes are unique, messageTemplates are non-empty, createPipelineError helper works correctly.

Create src/engines/__tests__/validationEngine.test.ts - test each validation function: permission violations produce correct errors, incompatible SKUs are detected, geometry violations (overlap, outside wall, too small) produce correct error codes, construction rule violations detected, BOM coherence checks work.

Create src/engines/__tests__/bomPipeline.test.ts - test full pipeline: (a) happy path with valid input produces SUCCESS, (b) permission violation at step 1 produces BLOCKED with no further steps executed, (c) geometry violation produces BLOCKED with error codes, (d) warnings from non-blocking steps accumulate in output, (e) pipeline chains all engines correctly.
acceptance_criteria: src/engines/errorCatalogue.ts exports PipelineError interface, ErrorCode enum with 28 codes, createPipelineError function
src/engines/validationEngine.ts exports validatePermissions, checkCompatibility, validateGeometry, validateConstruction, validateBom - all pure functions
src/engines/bomPipeline.ts exports runBomPipeline with 8-step sequential pipeline and BLOCKED/SUCCESS semantics
All new engine tests pass: npx vitest --run src/engines/__tests__/errorCatalogue.test.ts src/engines/__tests__/validationEngine.test.ts src/engines/__tests__/bomPipeline.test.ts
TypeScript strict mode passes: npx tsc --noEmit
verification: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run
findings: All 589 tests pass (517 existing + 72 new). TypeScript strict mode passes cleanly. The siteAdaptationEngine throws EngineError on invalid wall dimensions (e.g., width=0), so bomPipeline wraps the adaptation step in a try/catch to convert it to a BLOCKED pipeline result with GEO_WALL_DIMENSION_INVALID error code. The reconcileBomLines function merges lines by SKU+calculationRule key.
